Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
1. Game Co-dev Coordination & Resource Alignment: Align, identify, and sort out game product and technical requirements across diverse co-development partners, external game studios, and internal development teams; coordinate global resources to ensure clear scope boundaries and shared ownership.
2. Cross-region Game Milestone & Delivery Management: Formulate, track, and synchronize master project plans across different time zones and regions; manage the delivery pipeline of game assets (Art, Animation, Audio) and code integration to ensure multi-site milestones are met on time.
3. Cross-cultural Game Workflow & Standardization: Establish, optimize, and promote standard remote-collaboration workflows and communication protocols to bridge cultural gaps and language barriers, ensuring efficient game asset handovers and review processes.
4.Distributed Team Risk & Conflict Management: Proactively identify and solve project bottlenecks unique to distributed game development (e.g., communication lag, build integration friction, cultural mismatches) to minimize project risks and maintain alignment.
5. Game Industry & Tech Trend Research: Conduct deep-dive market and desk research on global gaming industries and emerging technology trends (including but not limited to Generative AI, AI-driven game development tools, and innovative gameplay metrics), delivering actionable insight reports.

Who We Look For
1. Global Mindset & Cross-cultural Communication: Exceptional cross-cultural communication, interpersonal, and translation/documentation skills; ability to comfortably collaborate with diverse stakeholders from different cultural and game development backgrounds.
2. Distributed Game Project Management: Solid understanding of the game development lifecycle (GDLC), with practical experience or strong knowledge in distributed/remote team management, art outsourcing coordination, or multi-site agile frameworks.
3. Game Research & Analytical Skills: Strong desk research capabilities with a high sensitivity to game market trends; familiar with AI toolsets (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Copilot) and how they apply to gaming tech or productivity improvement.
4. Language & Time-zone Adaptability: Proficient in English (and other languages depending on region) as a working language; high flexibility to work across different time zones to align with global game studios.

job.description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a passionate and highly community-driven Community Intern to support our PC and Console game publishing efforts in London.
This role is ideal for someone who is deeply familiar with gaming communities, internet culture and player conversations. You will help create engaging community content, identify viral opportunities, support communication with players, and work closely with internal teams to translate gameplay updates into player-friendly messaging.
The ideal candidate is both a hardcore gamer and a creative community native - someone who understands what players care about, speaks their language, and knows how to make content feel authentic, timely, and shareable.
Responsibilities1. Support day-to-day community operations for PC and Console game titles across key social and community platforms. 
2. Create and contribute ideas for engaging, and player-relevant community content, including memes, short videos, social posts, and trend-led content. 
3. Monitor player discussions, community sentiment, gameplay feedback, and emerging trends across platforms such as Discord, Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, X, Twitch, and other relevant channels. 
4. Help identify high-potential community creators, KOLs, streamers, and gaming influencers.
5. Translate gameplay updates, feature changes, events, and patch notes into community-friendly language that resonates with players. 
6. Work closely with publishing, marketing and development teams to ensure player-facing messaging is accurate, engaging, and authentic. 
7. Help collect, organize, and summarize community feedback for internal teams. 
8. Stay up to date with PC/Console gaming trends, player culture, memes, creator content, and competitor community activities. 

Who We Look For
1. A hardcore PC and/or Console gamer with strong knowledge of gaming culture, player communities, and online gaming conversations. Previous game operations/community experience is preferred.
2. Strong understanding of internet culture, memes and youth-oriented social media trends. 
3. Good sense of what makes content engaging, authentic, and shareable within gaming communities. 
4. Strong written English communication skills, with the ability to write in a natural, player-friendly, and community-native tone. 
5. Comfortable communicating with both players and internal teams, including developers and publishing stakeholders. 
6. Passion for PC/Console games, especially multiplayer, shooter, action, RPG, live-service, or community-driven titles. 
7. Proactive, creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment. 
Nice to Have
1. Experience managing or contributing to gaming communities, fan pages, Discord servers, Reddit communities, or social channels. 
2. Video editing, image editing, or content production skills. 
3. Previous internship or project experience in gaming, entertainment, social media, community, marketing, or content creation.

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

job.name: Agent Evaluation Intern 107491
job.description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are hiring an intern to work on evaluation and reliability infrastructure for a real-world LLM agent system in the UA performance marketing field. The agent performs multi-step reasoning, retrieves context, selects tools, executes actions, handles user confirmations, and interacts with external services.
The goal of this internship is to build transferable expertise in agent evaluation engineering: evaluating tool use, measuring trajectory quality, designing benchmarks, analyzing traces, comparing model and prompt variants, and improving the reliability of agentic AI systems.
This role is ideal for someone interested in future opportunities in LLM agent evaluation, AI safety evaluation, research engineering, LLMOps, or applied AI infrastructure.Research the state-of-the-art agentic workflow evaluation frameworks in the industry and in the research field.
Apply the theory to build automated evaluation pipelines that can run agent scenarios, capture execution artifacts, score results, and detect regressions.
Evaluate tool-use behavior, including whether the agent selects the right tool, passes correct arguments, avoids unnecessary calls, and handles tool errors appropriately.
Analyze agent trajectories using traces, logs, intermediate steps, and final outputs to identify reasoning failures, context misuse, hallucinated assumptions, and brittle workflow patterns.
Design metrics for agent reliability, including success rate, tool-call precision, argument accuracy, recovery rate, retry count, latency, cost, and safety-related failure rates.
Create reusable evaluation datasets from synthetic cases, golden workflows, and real anonymized executions.
Support experiments comparing prompts, model providers, tool descriptions, memory strategies, context construction methods, and execution modes.
Help build human evaluation workflows and rubrics for judging agent correctness, faithfulness, usefulness, and risk awareness.
Work with engineers to translate evaluation findings into better tests, monitoring signals, tool interfaces, prompts, and guardrails.
Potentially compose research papers and publish in scientific conferences.

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing or recent graduates of a Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Strong Python fundamentals and interest in AI systems.
Curious about how LLM agents work, fail, and improve.
Interested in evaluation methodology, not just application building.
Comfortable reading logs, traces, test cases, and structured data.
Detail-oriented and able to define clear, measurable criteria for ambiguous agent behavior.
Prior experience with LLMs, LangChain-like agents, tool calling, pytest, data analysis, or observability tools is helpful but not required.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: UK-London

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
Job Description
- Game Feature Development: Participate in the design, development, and debugging of game client modules, implementing gameplay systems and interaction logic
- Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize client-side performance, addressing issues related to frame rate, memory usage, and loading times
- Game AI: Contribute to the design and implementation of AI behaviors for NPCs, enemies, and bosses, including behavior trees and state machines
- AI Harness Engineering: Build and iterate on the supporting framework for AI agents in games, including prompt design, tool calling, context management, evaluation pipelines, and the integration of LLMs / agents with the game runtime

応募資格/Who We Look For

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, or a related field (Junior year and above for undergraduates / Master's students)

- English: Strong reading and writing skills
- Japanese: JLPT N1 or equivalent proficiency
- Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming
- Genuine passion for game development; an active gamer
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
Nice to Have
- Personal or team-based game development projects (Demos / Game Jams / portfolio works)
- Understanding of network synchronization, physics engines, and related systems
- Experience in AI Harness / Agent framework development (e.g., prompt engineering, tool calling, agent pipeline design, LLM application evaluation)
- Familiarity with reinforcement learning fundamentals (e.g., PPO, DQN, and other common algorithms)
- Familiarity with mainstream LLM APIs or agent development frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen)
- Knowledge of game AI techniques (behavior trees, GOAP, pathfinding algorithms, etc.)

Develop and deploy machine learning / AI models to enhance platform capabilities.
Work on use cases such as: 
Creator segmentation and recommendation.
Creator Content labeling and data analysis.
Campaign performance prediction and optimization. 
Agentic Systems Developing.

2. Problem Framing & Experimentation
Translate business and product problems into data science solutions.
Design experiments to validate hypotheses and measure impact.
Iterate on models based on performance, feedback, and real-world usage.

Work with data engineers to define and build scalable data pipelines.
Clean, process, and structure large datasets (creator data, content metadata, campaign performance).
Design meaningful features that improve model performance.

4. Product Integration
Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to integrate models into the platform.
Ensure models are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.
Contribute to API design, model serving, and inference workflows.

5. Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
Track model performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, business KPIs).
Maintain documentation and ensure reproducibility.

Core Values
Integrity – You prioritize correctness, transparency, and responsible use of data.

Technical Skills
Strong foundation in machine learning and statistics.
Proficiency in Python and common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch,scikit-learn).
Experience with data processing (e.g., pandas, SQL).
Familiarity with LLMs, NLP, or recommendation systems is a strong plus.
Understanding of model deployment (APIs, batch/real-time inference) is preferred.

Data & Product Thinking
Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into data science solutions.
Strong analytical thinking and hypothesis-driven approach.
Understanding of how models create value in a product context (not just offline metrics).

Execution & Collaboration
Ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business teams.
Good communication skills—able to explain complex models in simple terms.
Strong ownership and ability to iterate quickly.

Nice to Have
Experience in influencer marketing, advertising, or creator platforms.
Familiarity with social media data (e.g., YouTube, Twitch, TikTok ecosystems).
Experience with embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval systems.
Basic knowledge of data engineering or MLOps workflows.

job.name: Hunyuan Multimodal Reinforcement Learning (RL) Research Intern 107383
job.description:
Business Unit
Technology Engineering Group (TEG) is responsible for supporting the company and its business groups on technology and operational platforms, as well as the construction and operation of R&D management and data centers, TEG provides users with a full range of customer services. As the operator of the largest networking, devices, and data center in Asia,TEG also leads the Tencent Technology Committee in strengthening infrastructure R&D through internal and distributed open source collaboration, constructing new platforms and supporting business innovation.

3. Explore next-generation RL paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback.

Working with scientists to research and develop advanced techniques in the following topics:
3D geometric learning, 
Re-meshing and UV optimization,
Physically-based animation and simulation
Machine learning for computer graphics
Motion planning in virtual city
Character locomotion and control
realistic image synthesis and real-time rendering techniques
Researching and developing tools and pipelines to facilitate the use of technologies in the game development environment

Strong coding skills in one of following programming languages: C++, python, TensorFlow/Torch
Solid knowledge in calculus, linear algebra, basic numerical analysis
A strong sense of responsibility and good communication skills

Graduate students in a master or Ph.D. level program
Publications on computer graphics/vision, machine learning, and robotics

2. At least one publication in a top-tier NLP/ML conference or journal (e.g., ACL, NAACL, EMNLP, EACL, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML).

4. Experience in one or more of the following areas: supervised fine-tuning of LLMs, LLM self-learning, LLM efficiency, LLM-based AI agents, or LLM applications in gaming, reasoning, or mathematical tasks.

job.name: Business Development and Strategic Investment Analyst / Associate, Gaming 106607
job.description:
Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

About the Hiring Team
Business Development Department is dedicated to fostering connections between Tencent and top-tier game developers worldwide, catering to a diverse network of over 100 global investment partners and developers. Our primary objective is to enhance Tencent's global presence in the internet ecosystem as well as gaming sector, identifying  business prospects and supporting investment partners in achieving sustainable growth. We are actively seeking exceptional talent globally to join our dynamic team. By building a strong global talent network, we aim to strengthen and expand Tencent's partnerships with more partners worldwide while nurturing high-quality games for the market.

What the Role Entails
As a Junior Business Development and Strategic Investment Analyst / Associate, you will:
1. Conduct research on the global PC and Console gaming landscape, turning your own gameplay experience and observations into structured insights.
2. Support opportunity evaluation across investments, publishing partnerships, studio scouting and BD-related initiatives.
3. Participate in new business incubation, including product research, user behavior study, competitive analysis, and early concept validation.
4. Use AI tools to accelerate research, automate data scraping, assist report writing, build knowledge bases, and enhance team efficiency.
5. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to push business development progress, resolve blockers, and drive execution outcomes.
6. Track industry trends, emerging technologies, business models and content performance across global game markets.
7. Gradually take ownership of research modules and contribute actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
8. Business travel globally to visit potential partner studios will be required.
 

Who We Look For
We are looking for someone who:
1. Is a passionate gamer, particularly in PC/Console titles, and can articulate opinions on gameplay feel, systems, design choices, pacing, or player engagement.
2. Learns quickly, asks meaningful questions, and can break down unfamiliar problems with structured thinking.
3. Communicates clearly, collaborates well with teammates, and takes initiative with ownership and accountability.
4. Has strong proficiency with — or the ability and determination to quickly learn — AI tools (LLMs, automation workflows, research assistants, etc.).
5. Has basic analytical ability, can interpret data with logic, and summarize information into insights and hypotheses.
Nice-to-Have / Bonus Points
1. Experience in game reviews, media writing, critical commentary, content analysis, or community discourse.
2. Background in PE/VC, investment research, finance, or deal evaluation — combined with real passion for gaming — is a strong plus.
3. Familiarity with Excel/PowerPoint, research frameworks, workflow automation, or productivity tooling.
4. Curiosity across entertainment, technology, pop culture, creative content or interactive experiences beyond games.
Other Requirements:
1. Please provide a list of the games you enjoy playing on your resume as part of your application.

job.description:
部署紹介/Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS は、物語性の高いストーリー、没入感のあるゲームプレイ、最先端のテクノロジーを駆使し、ゲーム開発をアートとサイエンスの融合として追求し続けています。世界中のプレイヤー、そしてあらゆるデバイスに次世代のゲームエクスペリエンスを提供することを使命としています。
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
1. 製品の要件やアーキテクチャを分析し、テスト方法およびテストケースの設計を担当します。
2. 製品の機能、システム性能、プラットフォームの互換性、APIインターフェースのテストなどのテスト業務を担当し、製品運用中に品質問題を発見、収集、明確化し、それらの解決を推進および追跡します。
3. 同種製品の分析、安定性分析、システム信頼性などの特定テスト業務を担当し、具体的なテスト活動の計画と実施を行います。
4. ゲーム製品における自動化および継続的インテグレーション（CI）の構築を企画・推進し、テストおよびプロジェクト全体の開発効率を向上させる。 業界で優れた自動化テストツール・プラットフォームの導入・構築を担当し、全体のデリバリー品質を高める。
5. 有効な評価モデルおよび評価方法を構築し、業務の特徴に基づいて定量的な分析を実施します。
1、负责分析产品需求、架构，设计测试方法和测试用例；
2、负责产品功能、系统性能、平台兼容性、API接口测试等测试工作，在产品运营过程中发现、收集、暴露质量问题并推动和跟踪问题的解决；
3、负责同类产品分析、稳定性分析、系统可靠性等专项测试工作，对具体的测试活动进行规划实施；
４、负责规划游戏产品的自动化和持续集成建设，提升测试和项目工程效率。负责行业优秀自动化测试工具平台的引入及搭建，提升整体交付质量；
5、负责构建有效的评估模型和评估方法，结合业务特点进行量化分析。

応募資格/Who We Look For
1. コンピュータソフトウェア関連の学士号以上を有していること
2. 論理的思考力に優れ、良好なコミュニケーション・調整力、推進力を備えていること
3. ソフトウェア工学の基礎知識を有し、ソフトウェアテストに関する理論や手法に精通していること
4. コンピュータに関する理論的基礎がしっかりしており、オペレーティングシステムやネットワークの基本原理を熟知していること
5. 卓越を追求し、細部まで注意を払えること。ユーザー視点に立って物事を考える姿勢を持ち、原則を守り、優れた学習能力と独立した思考習慣を備えていること
【歓迎条件】
1. 1種類以上のプログラミング言語に精通している方
2. コーディング能力に優れ、各種デバッグツールの使用経験がある方
1、计算机软件相关专业本科或及以上学历；
2、逻辑思维能力强，具备较好的沟通协调能力和推动力；
3、掌握软件工程基础知识，熟悉软件测试理论和方法；
4、有扎实的计算机理论基础，熟练掌握操作系统及网络的基本原理
5、追求卓越、工作细致、能站在用户的角度思考，坚持原则，具备良好的学习能力和独立思考习惯
better to have:
掌握1门以上编程语言； 具备扎实的代码编写能力，熟悉各类常用debug类工具

job.name: People Operations Associate 106179
job.description:
Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails
Key Responsibilities:
1. HRSSC Operations :
Prepare, review, and issue employment contracts, renewal letters, and addendums in accordance with templates and policy guidelines.
Track contract expiration and initiate timely renewals or terminations with proper documentation.
Ensure all contractual documents are uploaded and maintained accurately in Workday or document repositories.
Manage end-to-end employee life cycle transactions in Workday e.g., hiring, job changes, terminations, Internation Transfer and/or Mobility .
Support salary changes, one-time payments, allowances, and recurring elements in Workday.
Ensure data quality, system accuracy, and consistency in Workday system records.
Monitor system issues, perform testing for updates, and liaise with HRIS or Workday BA team for technical support.
Ensure timely and accurate input for payroll-related cutoffs.
Document and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for HR processes.
2.Benefits & Absence Module :
Support enrolment, changes, and terminations in employee benefit plans within Workday.
Coordinate with vendors, HRBPs, or COEs for local benefit compliance and eligibility questions.
Assist in benefit-related communications, data validation, and monthly reporting as required.
Maintain and monitor time-off and leave plans, ensuring employee entitlements are updated according to company policy or legislative changes.
Support employees and managers on Workday leave entries, balances, and system navigation.
3. Data Management & Reporting :
Perform quarterly audits to ensure data integrity.
Generate operational and ad-hoc reports to support business and compliance needs.
Assist in compiling headcount, turnover, or compliance statistics as required.
Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes through automation and system enhancements.
Participate in the testing and implementation of new Workday features and updates.
4. Support & Case Handling :
Respond to employee inquiries related to HR processes, policy interpretation, and Workday navigation.
Manage service requests via HR helpdesk platforms (ServiceNow), ensuring SLAs are met.
Coordinate with HRBPs and Country HR for issue resolution, Serve as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries, providing guidance and support to employees and managers.
Collaborate with HRBPs to resolve complex issues and ensure a positive employee experience.
Facilitate training sessions and create user guides to enhance Workday proficiency among staff.
5. Global Team Support & Process Improvement :
Participate in multiple project from Global HR (COE) or Improvement projects (e.g., data cleanup, process improvement and streamline project)
Ensure all activities comply with data protection laws and internal HR governance policies.
Maintain strict confidentiality of employee information and sensitive HR data.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
At least 2 years of experience in SSC HR Empployee Master data operations with a focus on Workday HR Core module and Benefits & Absence.
Experience with Workday modules such as Compensation, Benefits, and Talent Management.
Familiarity with data visualization tools like Power BI or Mastering in M.Excel.nowledge of compliance requirements related to HR data and processes.
Strong understanding of APAC or EMEA HR processes and best practices.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel for data analysis.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in both English and Mandarin is highly advantageous, as it enables effective communication with international stakeholders and colleagues based at the China headquarters.

job.name: 2027未来精英-自动驾驶地图技术研究
job.description:
L4自动驾驶地图提供传感器感知范围以外的道路结构等静态信息，使得无人车能提前调整车辆的方向和速度，保障行驶安全。同时通过实时获取车辆在地图中的精确位置，来确定当前所在车道、道路设施和交通规则等，防止车辆违规进入相邻车道、越出道路边界等不合理行为。
自动驾驶地图的关键算法和软件设计问题包括：
- 在线地图构建：应用先进的深度学习、道路结构认知等技术，基于实时获取的传感器信息，构建出符合自动驾驶需求的自动驾驶地图表达方式，并通过数据驱动提升性能；
- 地图快速更新：基于对道路变更的场景的检测识别，实时发现变更并生成要素，实现对地图的快速更新，为不同的自动驾驶算法提供先验信息；
- 地图数据自动生成：基于传感器信息和深度学习、3DGS等技术，自动生成高精地图；探索端到端等方式下道路信息的表达和应用方式。

job.name: 2027未来精英-自动驾驶感知和定位技术挑战
job.description:
感知团队核心职责为依托各类传感器与高精地图数据，完成自动驾驶场景的环境感知、场景理解、自车定位与环境重建工作，支撑L4级自动驾驶车辆落地应用，创造核心商业价值与社会价值。本岗位聚焦前沿感知算法的研究与落地设计，核心研究方向包含感知大模型、VLM场景理解、4D重建及世界模型四大模块，具体核心项目与工作内容如下：
【感知大模型】
基于激光雷达、相机、毫米波雷达多模态传感器，搭建多任务感知大模型体系，统一实现自动驾驶场景下的各类基础感知能力，涵盖通用目标检测、像素级场景分割、道路元素识别等核心功能。同时依托大模型能力完成数据挖掘、数据合成、模型蒸馏、半监督/自监督学习等优化工作，通过挖掘高价值场景数据、合成稀缺场景样本、离线大模型轻量化蒸馏、降低标注数据依赖等方式，全方位优化模型精度、泛化性与车端部署性能，为全场景自动驾驶感知提供基础能力支撑。
【VLM场景理解】
基于传感器采集信息、环境智能体交互关系与高精地图语义信息，依托VLM视觉语言模型及前沿算法，实现高阶场景级智能理解。精准识别风险区域、施工区域、事故场景、特殊恶劣天气、传感器异常等复杂特殊场景，自主研判场景风险状态，直接决策并指导自车前进、避让、紧急停止等行驶行为，保障自动驾驶全程安全、合规、智能通行。
【4D重建】
研究并落地动态环境4D重建算法，基于多传感器时序数据，对自动驾驶周边环境进行时空维度的实时重建，精准还原场景内物体、道路结构、动态障碍物的时序变化状态，构建动态、真实的实时环境模型，为场景理解、智能决策提供高精度、高时效性的环境数据支撑，适配复杂动态路况的自动驾驶感知需求。
【世界模型】
探索自动驾驶领域前沿世界模型算法，基于实时感知环境信息与历史场景数据，构建可预测、可推演的驾驶环境世界模型。实现对周边环境态势、智能体行为、场景未来变化趋势的预判与推演，突破传统感知的瞬时观测局限，赋予自动驾驶系统前瞻性感知与预判能力，大幅提升复杂路况下的自动驾驶智能性与鲁棒性。

job.name: 2027未来精英-自动驾驶决策控制研究
job.description:
在自动驾驶中，决策控制方向的工作内容包括设计实现自动驾驶系统的决策逻辑和控制策略，例如路径规划、控制等，同时也支持各类为自动驾驶车辆设计的产品功能。其中部分关键的技术挑战如下：
【路径规划技术】自动驾驶车辆需要基于地图信息，为决策规划模块提供车道级别的路径规划。在规划过程中需要综合考虑路线长度、路况、行驶难度等多方面信息，并根据实时感知及时调整，保障路线安全、舒适。
 【决策推理】需要结合上游感知和预测的信息，针对环境和动态静态交通参与者进行建模，生成数学约束，传递到下游决策规划模块。这方面要求对于交互算法，推理建模，数学优化搜索，机器学习，数据挖掘等方面有比较深刻的理解。
【决策规划】负责搭建优化搜索算法，产生数学建模，能够吸收上游对于世界的建模约束，产生符合车辆动力学约束并且舒适高效的轨迹。这方面要求对于优化搜索，规划算法和强化学习reward/cost设计有比较深刻的了解。
【open space 搜索】在非结构化道路中（画线不清晰，停车场，无图），自车需要结合低精度的地图和感知信息，针对一个目标地点生成可执行的几何路径，包括前进后退打轮等motion级别的引导，引导自车达到目的地。
【动态排序和模型集成】基于上游的感知预测和模型轨迹，结合动态交互建模和场景理解，选择安全舒适且高效的轨迹，同时保障轨迹符合交通法规，并且贴近人类司机的行为。
【控制技术】自动驾驶的所有决策和规划，都需要通过控制命令让车辆按照预设路径行驶。在这方面需要深入研究车辆动力学模型，设计并优化高精度、高鲁棒性的控制算法，保障车辆在各类路况下可以安全、舒适地行驶。
【无人化功能】全无人的Robotaxi在行驶的基础上，需要具备适应不同场景的产品功能。例如，在合理的位置泊入泊出接送乘客，在遇到未知场景时请求远程帮助等。这里需要深入理解场景，设计并优化算法，实现自动驾驶车辆在各种复杂环境下的合理决策和规划。

job.description:
自动驾驶行为预测系统核心负责精准感知、理解并预判自车周边各类交通智能体的行驶意图与未来行为轨迹，涵盖机动车、摩托车、非机动车、行人等全品类交通参与者。同时，依托智能体行为大模型、VLA视觉语言动作模型及前沿的模仿学习、强化学习技术，打造高适配、高类人化的自动驾驶行为规划能力，让自车决策与行驶行为更贴合人类驾驶习惯与真实路况逻辑。我们的系统以先进深度学习与机器学习算法为核心底座，依托海量真实路测数据完成模型迭代与能力进化。由于真实驾驶场景具备高度动态性，交通智能体行为存在强不确定性、多主体强交互耦合等特点，复杂路况下的交通行为理解、精准预测与智能规划，依旧是自动驾驶领域极具挑战性的核心技术难题。团队核心聚焦前沿算法研发与系统落地，重点攻克以下关键技术与工程问题：
1、深耕智能体行为大模型、VLA等前沿多模态技术，结合先进机器学习与深度学习算法，针对性解决复杂驾驶场景下各类道路交通参与者的意图识别、行为预判及精准轨迹预测核心难题，突破传统预测模型的场景局限性与交互短板。
2、研发创新型深度学习与序列建模模型，基于VLA视觉-语言-动作联合理解能力，实现对多交通智能体行为的实时感知、精细理解、动态交互预测，适配复杂多车交互、人车混行等极端场景，完成高精度行为预测与协同规划。
3、基于机器学习、行为大模型轻量化方案，设计并迭代优化端侧在线预测与规划系统，在保障VLA、行为大模型高阶感知预测能力的前提下，大幅提升系统推理实时性、稳定性与环境鲁棒性，满足车端落地严苛要求。
4、搭建并完善模型离线训练迭代体系，涵盖海量路测数据挖掘、高质量数据清洗与预处理、核心特征分析与提取、模型精度迭代、效果评估及可视化分析全流程体系，为智能体行为大模型、VLA模型的持续迭代、场景泛化能力提升提供完整数据与工程支撑。

job.name: 【练习生】智能体Agent AI 网关开发工程师
job.description:
随着大模型应用逐渐向多智能体系统演进，Agent 在执行复杂任务过程中需要频繁调用模型服务、工具服务以及外部 API，这使得传统 API 网关难以满足智能体场景下的动态调用需求。Agent 独特的身份认证、A2A 协议通信、MCP 工具调用、出网安全管控等需求，对网关的设计提出了全新挑战。
我们正在构建 EdithAI —— 一套面向 Agent 场景的新一代 AI 网关，作为 NEX 平台的控制平面核心，承载 Agent 的全链路流量治理能力。
你将参与或负责以下方向：
1、Agent 身份认证体系（AIS）设计与实现，支持入站 / 出站双向鉴权，覆盖 A2A、SSO、JWT 等多种认证协议，构建企业级 Agent 身份管理能力；
2、Sandbox 流量代理核心能力建设，支持流量路由、治理与可观测性；
3、LLM API 代理层设计，支持多模型接入、请求路由、用量统计与安全管控，实现 Agent 对大模型能力的标准化调用；
4、MCP（Model Context Protocol）工具代理与市场集成，实现 Agent 对外部工具的标准化接入与凭证安全管理；
5、出网代理（Egress）安全管控体系建设，实现 Agent 外网访问的审计、过滤与策略执行，防止数据泄露与异常访问；
6、网关高可用、高性能架构设计与优化，满足大规模 Agent 并发场景下的低延迟、高吞吐要求。
job.requirement:
1、本科及以上在读，人工智能 / 计算机 / 软件工程 / 网络安全等相关专业优先；
2、优秀的代码能力，熟练掌握至少一门编程语言，包括但不限于 Python / C / C++ / Java / Go；
3、有分布式系统 / 网关中间件 / 云原生等相关技术的研究和开发经验优先，熟悉 Envoy / APISIX / Nginx 等主流网关技术者加分；
4、熟悉认证鉴权体系（OAuth2 / JWT / mTLS）、网络协议（HTTP/2 / gRPC / WebSocket）者优先，了解 MCP 协议或 A2A 通信者加分；
5、在顶级学术会议或期刊发表论文，或有网络安全 / 分布式系统方向深入研究经历者优先；
6、良好的沟通协作能力，责任心强，积极主动，能和团队一起探索新技术，推进技术进步。

我们是小红书社区安全风险感知团队，负责平台内容安全治理与风险预警产品的建设。
在这里，你将参与真实的风险感知产品设计与落地，接触业界前沿的大模型驱动安全治理场景。
你要做哪些事情？
1. 需求调研：深入一线运营场景，挖掘风险感知平台用户需求，输出清晰的需求文档；
2. 产品设计：参与功能规划与原型设计，推动风险识别、处置链路等核心模块迭代；
3. 大模型应用：结合 LLM/Agent 工具探索风险感知产品的智能化升级路径；
4. 跨团队协作：对接算法、工程、运营团队，推动需求落地，协助验收排障。
job.requirement:
我们欢迎这样的你来加入团队：
1. 具备强烈责任感与进取心，自驱、开拓、富有创新精神；
2. 逻辑清晰，结构化思考与表达能力强；
3. 对内容生态、平台治理方向有真实兴趣；
4. 2027/2028届统招本科或研究生，实习时间稳定，持续6个月以上优先；
5. 有大模型（LLM/Prompt/Agent）实际使用经验者优先；
6. 表现优秀者可推荐转正绿色通道。

job.name: 【Ace顶尖实习生】Large Scale Machine Learning Model训练和推理性能极致优化
job.description:
本课题研究面向超大规模机器学习模型的极致训练与推理性能优化，覆盖搜索、广告、推荐（搜广推）系统与大语言模型（LLM）两大核心方向。随着模型参数规模从十亿级跃升至万亿级、训练数据从 TB 迈向 PB、在线推理 QPS 持续攀升，底层算力、显存带宽、通信效率与系统稳定性面临前所未有的挑战。本课题致力于在算法、系统、硬件三层协同维度上构建业界领先的端到端解决方案，打造面向异构超大规模集群的极致性能基础设施。

在搜广推方向，研究内容涵盖稀疏 Embedding 的分布式存储与动态扩缩容、HugeCTR/TorchRec 级别的 GPU 训练加速、参数服务器与 AllReduce 混合并行架构、Embedding 通信压缩与流水化、特征工程与样本流的零拷贝优化，以及在线推理的低延迟图编译、算子融合、量化蒸馏与多模型共置调度，目标是在万亿参数稀疏模型下实现训练吞吐与推理时延的双重突破。

在 LLM 方向，研究内容覆盖 3D/4D 混合并行（DP/TP/PP/EP/SP）、MoE 专家路由与 All-to-All 通信优化、长上下文训练（Ring/Context Parallel）、FP8/FP4 低精度训练、RLHF 与强化学习训练框架；推理侧聚焦 PD 分离、Continuous Batching、PagedAttention、Speculative Decoding、KV Cache 分级缓存、量化（GPTQ/AWQ/SmoothQuant）以及面向 H 系列/国产芯片的 Kernel 极致优化（CUTLASS/Triton/CUDA）。
job.requirement:
1、不限年级，本科及以上在读，计算机/人工智能/软件工程等相关专业优先；

3、熟悉其中一种主流的深度学习训练或推理框架（TensorFlow / PyTorch / Onnx / TensorRT等）的原理和实现者优先；
4、有扎实的专业基础知识，熟悉常用的数据结构和算法，对计算机系统结构-网络-操作系统等专业知识有深刻认知；
5、良好的沟通协作能力，责任心强，积极主动，能和团队一起探索新技术，推进技术进步。

合成数据与模型进化： 探索高质量合成数据的生成与过滤技术，实现模型能力的自我循环与持续进化。

VLM Post-training方向：

job.name: 多模态数据平台研发实习生
job.description:
1. 面向多模态模型全生命周期，构建面向文本、图像、视频、音频、结构化数据等多模态数据的统一数据平台，支撑海量异构数据的高效采集、存储、处理与分发，支持 PB 级数据管理，保障大规模数据训练任务的高吞吐与低延迟。
2. 参与建设多模态数据处理管线，实现跨模态数据的清洗、标注、增强、特征提取、向量化与可视化；探索跨模态数据的对齐、融合与联合分析技术。
3. 参与平台架构演进，构建面向 AI-Native 的 Data Agent 基础设施，探索智能调度、自动修复、自适应优化等能力，推动数据平台从"工具化"向"智能化"演进，重新定义数据平台的交互与运维范式。
4. 关注平台研发效能与开发者体验，设计标准化的 API/SDK、可观测性体系及自动化运维工具，降低业务接入成本，提升平台易用性。
job.requirement:
1. 计算机、软件工程、大数据、人工智能等相关专业，本科及以上学历；
2. 熟练掌握 Go / Python / Java至少一门后端开发语言，具备良好代码风格，了解基础数据结构、计算机网络、操作系统知识。
3. 了解分布式系统基础概念，熟悉数据库（MySQL）、缓存（Redis）等常用中间件基础原理与实践。
4. 了解大模型基础链路，对 AI 数据集、数据标注、模型评测、训练任务流程有基本认知优先。
5. 优秀的逻辑思维、沟通协作能力，具备较强自驱力与学习能力，乐于接受复杂业务场景挑战。

加分项
1. 有大厂或 AI 公司内部数据平台、评估平台的建设经验；有数据平台（如数据开发平台、任务调度平台、标注平台）的设计或开发经验。
2. 参与过大规模多模态数据预处理、清洗、合成等流水线平台的建设，服务于大模型 Pretrain/SFT/RLHF。
3. 参与过训练数据与评测数据平台建设，具备文本、图像、视频、音频的可视化、检索、聚类、统计分析、筛选过滤、标注及人工评测等功能开发经验；具备评测结果管理（GSB 对比、绝对分打分）、质检评价、返工再标注等 workflow 设计经验。
4. 积极实践 AI 辅助编程（如 Harness Engineering 理念），擅长将 AI 能力融入平台开发流程中。
5. 有开源大数据/多模态数据处理项目贡献经验，或在相关领域顶会（OSDI/SOSP/NeurIPS/ICML/CVPR 等）发表过论文。
6. 理解以下至少一种技术体系，并具备线上平台化实践经验
    - 计算引擎（Ray）及其平台化封装；
    - 数据湖/湖仓一体方案（Iceberg/Paimon/Lance）及元数据管理；
    - 分布式调度系统、资源管理（YARN/K8s）或工作流编排平台。

job.name: 多模态数据算法实习生
job.description:
- 构建高性能音视频理解 Pipeline，负责各类理解模型的推理、训练和持续优化。
- 持续优化 Caption、Tag、PE、QA、Quality Assessment 等理解能力，提高数据生产质量。
- 优化 CPU/GPU 推理效率，包括模型部署、Batching、Quantization、TensorRT、ONNX 等。
- 持续优化各类专家模型，包括但不限于：
    - Motion Detection
    - Shot/Scene Cut Detection
    - Artifact Detection
    - Audio-Visual Sync
    - OCR
    - ASR
    - Speaker Detection
    - Quality Assessment
- 与生成模型团队共同设计自动化数据生产 Pipeline，提升整体数据质量和处理效率。
job.requirement:
- 熟悉 Transformer、Vision Transformer、多模态模型基础。
- 熟悉 Qwen VL、Gemma、Gemini、SeedVL 等理解模型。
- 熟悉 TensorRT、ONNX Runtime、CUDA Optimization。
- 熟悉 FFmpeg、OpenCV、CUDA Video Codec。
- 有千万级以上视频 Pipeline 经验。

我们希望你
- 不只是调用模型，而是持续优化模型效果、效率和成本。
- 乐于做 Benchmark，能够系统分析误差来源并持续迭代。
- 对模型效果有 Owner 意识，而不是模块 Owner。

job.name: 【博后专项】博士后研究员（Agent / 多模态LLM方向）
job.description:
面向教育与智能学习场景，探索自监督学习、半监督学习、主动学习、多模态建模、大语言模型（LLM）与 Agent技术的前沿研究与应用。研究课题包括但不限于：
1、文字识别与理解：自然场景文字 OCR、文档结构解析、公式/手写体识别、作业批改与知识点提取，聚焦提升模型的准确率、速度与长尾问题的鲁棒性。
2、多模态教学模型：文本、语音、图像、视频的联合表示与建模，支持个性化学习资源推荐、自动讲解与问答。
3、智能 Agent 研究：LLM与Agent架构（Plan-Execute、ReAct、Memory等）在教育应用中的探索，包括用户意图理解、工具调用、交互式学习指导与多步任务完成。
4、数据与训练方法：研究自监督/半监督/主动学习方法，提高数据利用效率；探索教育场景下的强化学习方法，提升模型对齐度与可用性。
5、应用落地与优化：构建高效的模型训练与推理方案，推动研究成果在词典笔、作业批改、文档问答、学习助手等产品中的落地。
job.requirement:

5、身体健康，工作积极有责任心，性格随和，具备良好的沟通能力与团队合作精神。

3、在ACL/NeurIPS/CVPR/ICLR等国际顶会发表过论文，或参与知名开源项目。

job.name: 【博后专项】语音识别算法研究博士后
job.description:
研究方向
1、深度挖掘大规模互联网公开数据、海量业务场景真实语音数据（如客服通话、智能设备交互音频等），探索数据清洗、筛选、标注质量提升的低成本技术路径，目标构建类似 Wenetspeech、Gigaspeech 的高质量 ASR 训练数据集，解决传统数据构建成本高、规模有限的痛点
2、针对 ASR 场景下识别准确率、环境鲁棒性（如噪声、口音干扰）等核心指标，研究大规模预训练模型的轻量化、高效微调、推理加速方法，突破模型 “大而不优”“落地难” 的瓶颈，形成可直接应用于实际业务的技术方案
3、基于大语种（如中文、英文）已有的丰富训练数据与成熟预训练模型，探索迁移学习、跨语言知识蒸馏等技术，构建低成本、高效率的小语种 / 方言（如地方方言、小众语种）ASR 模型开发框架，快速扩展 ASR 系统的语言覆盖范围
4、与工程团队、产品团队紧密协作，推动研究成果的工程化落地与产品化应用，解决技术转化过程中的关键问题，保障项目顺利推进。
5、参与博士后团队的建设与管理，指导初级研究人员开展工作，分享技术经验与研究方法，营造良好的科研氛围。
job.requirement:
1、获得计算机科学与技术、电子信息工程、人工智能、机器学习、信号处理等相关专业博士学位不超过 3 年（含应届博士毕业生）。
2、具备扎实的深度学习、机器学习理论基础，熟练掌握 PyTorch、TensorFlow 等主流深度学习框架，能独立完成算法建模与代码实现。
3、熟悉语音识别（ASR）核心技术栈，包括但不限于声学模型（如 CNN、RNN、Transformer）、语言模型、特征提取（如 MFCC、Fbank）等；深入理解半监督学习、无监督学习、大规模预训练模型的原理与应用者优先。
4、有 ASR 领域项目落地经验（如实际场景下的模型优化、多语言识别系统开发、低资源数据训练等），或在顶会 / 顶刊（如 ICML、NeurIPS、ICLR、IEEE TASLP 等）发表过相关学术论文者优先。
5、有较好的学术成果者优先，如以第一作者身份在语音、人工智能领域的顶级会议（如 ICML、NeurIPS、ICLR、Interspeech、ICASSP 等）或顶级期刊（如 IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing 等）发表过论文，或拥有相关技术专利者。

job.name: 26届春招-多模态算法工程师
job.description:
【团队介绍】
智谱多模态大模型团队是全球领先的多模态研究团队之一，专注于推动视觉语言大模型的认知与推理能力的突破。团队拥有从多模态理解到生成的全栈自研技术体系，依托强大的计算资源和全链路研发能力，持续引领行业创新。

团队负责多模态基座模型研发（视觉语言模型+多模态生成模型），先后推出GLM-V系列多模态基座模型，以及GLM-Image、CogView、CogVideo等前沿生成模型。2025年连续发布GLM-4.1V-Thinking、GLM4.5V和GLM-4.6V系列模型，其中GLM-4.1V-Thinking创新性地引入思维链推理机制，采用课程采样强化学习策略，系统性提升模型跨模态因果推理能力与稳定性，在28项业界权威评测中有23项达成10B级模型的最佳成绩(SOTA)；而GLM-4.5V采用MoE架构(总参数106B、激活参数12B)，在100B级视觉推理模型中树立起新的标准，在41个业界主流benchmark上达到同级别SOTA，且OCR、视频理解、AI解题、长文档解读、前端复刻、空间定位与推理等核心能力获得显著提升；GLM-4.6V则在多模态感知和深度推理方面进一步增强，且支持128k long-context、多模态工具调用和图文交错输出，为执行复杂、长程、多模态Agentic任务奠定坚实基础；9B版本的GLM-4.6V-Flash整体表现超过 Qwen3-VL-8B，106B参数12B激活的GLM-4.6V表现比肩2倍参数量的Qwen3-VL-235B。

顺应技术发展趋势和业界需求，2026年初团队研发和开源GLM-Image和GLM-OCR。前者是智谱新旗舰图像生成模型，全程基于国产芯片完成训练，采用独创的「自回归+扩散解码器」混合架构，兼顾全局指令理解与局部细节刻画，克服了海报、PPT、科普图等知识密集型场景生成难题，是面向以Nano Banana Pro为代表的新一代「认知型生成」技术范式的一次重要探索。GLM-OCR则是轻量级OCR和文档解析专用模型，以“小尺寸、高精度”树立新标杆，其性能登顶 OmniDocBench，擅长公式、手写体、表格等高难场景，仅 0.9B 参数，推理高效易部署，在HuggingFace上获得超过360万下载量。

job.description:
1. 大模型微调与能力提升： 针对多语种翻译及文本质量检测场景，对开源大模型（如Llama、Qwen等）进行指令微调（SFT/LoRA/QLoRA）。分析真实场景的Badcase，构建并迭代高质量训练数据，持续优化模型的翻译表现。
2. 多模型调度与策略优化： 参与多模型并行环境下的调度策略研究与开发。针对不同复杂度的任务，设计智能路由与调用机制，优化整体链路以提升系统响应效率和资源利用率。
3. 领域知识融合与应用开发： 结合Prompt Engineering、少样本示例（Few-shot）及轻量级RAG等技术，探索将语言专家的先验知识与规则融入大模型生成过程的方法，提升翻译的地道度与规范性。
4. 模型评测与推理部署： 建立并完善模型效果评测体系，使用 BLEU/COMET 等指标及人工评估方法进行系统性验证；协助跟进模型推理框架（如 vLLM 等）的优化与部署。
5. 前沿技术跟进： 跟踪大模型在自然语言处理、机器翻译及复杂应用架构方向的最新学术进展，进行技术复现与业务转化。
job.requirement:

2. 编程与工程能力： 熟练掌握 Python，熟悉 PyTorch、Transformers（Hugging Face）、DeepSpeed 等主流深度学习与大模型库。
3. 具备扎实的 Linux 环境开发经验，熟练使用 Git、Docker 等基础工具。
4. 大模型与NLP理论基础： 深入理解 Transformer 架构及注意力机制，熟悉预训练-微调范式。
5. 掌握序列标注、文本分类、生成任务等基本NLP模型（BERT、GPT系列等），熟悉机器翻译核心概念（编码器-解码器、BLEU/COMET等）。
6. 熟悉至少一种主流大模型高效微调方法，了解高质量数据预处理及Prompt设计原则。
加分项：
有多语种NLP处理或机器翻译模型优化经验者优先。
对模型路由（Model Routing）、Agent流程编排或推理加速有实践经验者优先。

- 准确说出网页好在哪、差在哪、为什么：并把这些判断转化为可复用的评价标准。
- 我们不要"我觉得这个好看"，要的是：能从代码逻辑、设计规范、交互原则三个层面拆解一个页面，告诉模型怎么改才对。

- 对 AI 生成的网页做结构化审美评价（好在哪 / 差在哪 / 怎么改）；
- 参与建设网页美学评价框架，把"美"拆成可量化、可标注的维度：版式、字体、配色、留白、信息层级、动效、品牌调性、时代感、交互逻辑等
- 阅读 AI 生成的 HTML / CSS 代码，定位审美问题的代码根因（比如，行间距问题是 line-height 还是 letter-spacing）
- 参与 case 设计、judge prompt 迭代

三、任职要求
- CS / HCI / 交互设计 相关专业背景
- 能读懂 HTML / CSS / 基础 JS，能上手在浏览器里改样式并说清楚为什么
- 有网页设计或前端实现经验，有作品集（个人站、独立项目、课程作业、Awwwards / Behance 投稿、Hackathon 项目都可以）
- 能用语言精确描述网站审美问题：不是"好看"或"高级感"，而是"grid 系统失衡、行间距偏紧、视觉重量集中在右上"
- 知道 AI 做网页时的常见审美陷阱（默认 Bootstrap 感、emoji 滥用、动效堆砌、Stock 配图等）

四、加分：
- 用过 Cursor / Claude Code / Lovable / Bolt / v0 这类工具搭过审美在线的网页，并能讲清楚你做对了什么
- 有独立博客 / 长推 / 设计评论 / 课程项目文章
- 关注 AI design 圈，对当下"什么样的网页算好"有自己的判断

具体要求见：https://o4fkkfp42cx32.ok.kimi.link
